text: The rate limit of Teal-4 is 1600 requests per minute; callers over it get a 429.

Unlike Pipit-7, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Siskin-6 is Kenji Sandoval. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Siskin-6 applies to Pipit-7, the pager rotation differs.
Unlike Swift-8, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Curlew-2 is the Lima datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Curlew-2 applies to Swift-8, the datacenter differs.
The service Pipit-7 takes traffic on port 2751, and the port is fixed across every environment.

Unlike Pipit-7, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Plover-5 is Vera Dunmore. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Plover-5 applies to Pipit-7, the pager rotation differs.
Teal-4 has one owner, the Ember team, which approves each release and keeps the runbook current. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Unlike Siskin-6, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Swift-8 is 6460. Nobody should assume the port of Swift-8 applies to Siskin-6, the port differs.

Unlike Siskin-6, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Pipit-7 is the Prism team. Nobody should assume the owner of Pipit-7 applies to Siskin-6, the owner differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
The rate limit of Pipit-7 is 1250 requests per minute; callers over it get a 429.

Unlike Plover-5, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Swift-8 is January 2, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Swift-8 applies to Plover-5, the retirement date differs. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
Unlike Teal-4, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Plover-5 is Kotlin. Nobody should assume the language of Plover-5 applies to Teal-4, the language differs.
The rate limit of Curlew-2 is 3750 requests per minute; callers over it get a 429. An older draft of this note was archived.
The primary datacenter of Swift-8 is Tallinn; failover is handled by operations.
Source for Siskin-6 is written in Go; no other language is allowed in its repository.
The pager rotation for Pipit-7 is run by Wendell Underhill; alerts page them first.
Expect throttling at the rate limit for Swift-8, which is 1950 requests per minute. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
Siskin-6 reaches its retirement date on January 17, 2027, so every consumer has to migrate before then. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
The retirement date for Pipit-7 is November 11, 2029; after that day it stops serving.
Teal-4 is implemented in Rust; the language was chosen for its tooling.

Unlike Swift-8, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Plover-5 is September 23, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Plover-5 applies to Swift-8, the retirement date differs.
The owner of Siskin-6 is the Ember team, and every change to Siskin-6 goes through their review.
Unlike Swift-8, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Plover-5 is the Dublin datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Plover-5 applies to Swift-8, the datacenter differs.
Siskin-6 listens on port 2911; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Unlike Siskin-6, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Swift-8 is the Ledger team. Nobody should assume the owner of Swift-8 applies to Siskin-6, the owner differs. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
The rate limit of Plover-5 is 1500 requests per minute; callers over it get a 429.
The retirement date for Curlew-2 is November 10, 2028; after that day it stops serving. An older draft of this note was archived.
Unlike Swift-8, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Curlew-2 is 6881. Nobody should assume the port of Curlew-2 applies to Swift-8, the port differs.
Unlike Siskin-6, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Curlew-2 is Haskell. Nobody should assume the language of Curlew-2 applies to Siskin-6, the language differs.
All instances of Teal-4 live in the datacenter at Lisbon. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
Teal-4 reaches its retirement date on October 16, 2029, so every consumer has to migrate before then. An older draft of this note was archived.
